say:1:1330206001:1.text: You see it, right? The water near the Floral Ruins has a higher temperature than other areas.
say:1:1330206001:1.source_cn: 你没看错，靠近古遗迹花海的河水，温度总会稍微高些。
say:1:1330206001:1.male: You see it, right? The water near the Floral Ruins has a higher temperature than other areas.
say:1:1330206001:1.female: You see it, right? The water near the Floral Ruins has a higher temperature than other areas.

say:2:1330206002:1.text: Rumor has it that the soldiers who protected the town during the Divine War were buried under the flowers.
say:2:1330206002:1.source_cn: 据说那片花海下面埋着神魔大战时守护镇子的士兵们。
say:2:1330206002:1.male: Rumor has it that the soldiers who protected the town during the Divine War were buried under the flowers.
say:2:1330206002:1.female: Rumor has it that the soldiers who protected the town during the Divine War were buried under the flowers.

say:3:1330206003:1.text: Perhaps, they are still guarding the town, with the flower field as their legacy.
say:3:1330206003:1.source_cn: 也许他们仍然在守护着镇子——那片温暖的花海，保留着他们...
say:3:1330206003:1.male: Perhaps, they are still guarding the town, with the flower field as their legacy.
say:3:1330206003:1.female: Perhaps, they are still guarding the town, with the flower field as their legacy.
